name: Nirog
what: Hospital software for Bangladeshi private hospitals and clinics: reception, doctors, nurses, lab, billing and pharmacy work in one staff workspace, and patients follow their live serial on their phone.
hard_part: Multi-tenant on Postgres row-level security: the server connects as a role that cannot bypass RLS and sets the hospital id per transaction, so another hospital's patient returns 404 and a forged cross-tenant insert is refused by the database. Money is integer paisa end to end, and bills are never deleted, only voided with a name and a reason.
demo_note: one-tap demo roles on /staff/ (reception, doctor, nurse, lab, billing, pharmacy, owner); fictional hospital, reset nightly
facts: Three surfaces in one Go binary: patient app, staff workspace, platform console
Staff app in Bangla and English
Allergy check on prescribing and selling, with an audited override
